title: fix(plugin-calendar): no resize handle in the week/day views without an end field; calendar-view forwards a host endEditable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbWFEE4TZR1T1myKpHHno2iQ)_

Fixes #29197

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：日历视图没有配置结束日期字段（`endDateField`）时，周视图和日视图的事件上不再画任何调整大小的拖拽柄，顶部「调整开始」柄也去掉了；拖动事件本身照旧可以移动。另外，按页面节点编写的 `calendar-view` 现在会把宿主传入的 `endEditable` 交给日历组件，和 `ObjectCalendar` 行为一致。
- **为什么改**：没有结束字段时，事件只是一个时间点。拖顶部柄会改写开始时间，然后事件又按一小时重画，看起来就是一次移动，用户以为在调整时长，实际上把记录挪了位置。#29020 已经去掉了底部和月视图的「调整结束」柄，这次补上剩下的顶部柄和页面节点这条路。
- **风险与回滚**：低。配置了结束字段的视图两个柄都保留，行为不变；宿主不传 `endEditable` 时 `calendar-view` 的行为也不变。`endEditable` 是 #29020 新加、尚未发版的属性，这次只是让它的 `false` 也覆盖顶部柄，类型没变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`CalendarView.tsx` 里周/日视图顶部柄的条件和 `handleEventPointerDown` 开头新增的拦截；`calendar-view-renderer.tsx` 新增的 `resolveAuthoredEndEditable` 与转交处；`ObjectCalendar.endEditable-29020.test.tsx` 里两条改了预期的用例。
- **两分钟验证**：在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-calendar/src/__tests__/CalendarView.noEndNoResize-29197.test.tsx`，预期 1 个文件、12 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`CalendarView`, week and day views:** `endEditable={false}` now also hides the top "Resize start" handle, so with no stored end the time grid draws no resize handle at all. `handleEventPointerDown` ignores the top and bottom zones when `endEditable` is `false`; a body drag still moves the event. The month view is as #29020 left it (no "Resize event end" handle). The prop's doc now says what `false` means: the events have no stored end, so no view draws a resize handle. The type is unchanged.
- **`ObjectCalendar`:** unchanged. It already passes `endEditable={Boolean(calendarConfig.endDateField)}`, so a view with no end field now draws no top handle either.
- **`calendar-view` renderer:** forwards a host's `endEditable` as a declared host hatch, the way it forwards `slotMinutes`: a boolean reaches `CalendarView`, anything else gets the absent-key answer (the default `true`). No registry input, `@object-ui/types` key or metadata key is added.
- **Docs:** one bullet under "Week / Day view" in `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx`.

**Premise note (why the renderer forwards rather than derives).** A `calendar-view` node's `endDateField` defaults to `end`: `CalendarViewSchema.endDateField` carries `@default 'end'` in `@object-ui/types`, and the renderer reads `schema.endDateField || 'end'`. So every authored node names an end field, and deriving `endEditable` from it would always give `true`. Only the host knows its records keep no end, so the renderer forwards the host's boolean. Handles need a host `onEventDrop` in the first place (JSON cannot carry a function), so the hatch sits beside the callback that makes them appear.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/__tests__/CalendarView.noEndNoResize-29197.test.tsx`, 12 cases:

- **`CalendarView` directly, week and day:** `endEditable={false}` draws neither the top nor the bottom handle. Control: the default draws both.
- **`ObjectCalendar`, week and day:** a view with no end field (with `allDayField` declared, so the record is drawn timed) draws no top handle and no bottom handle. Control: a view with an end field draws both.
- **`calendar-view` through `SchemaRenderer`:** a host `onEventDrop` with `endEditable: false` draws neither time-grid handle in the week view and no "Resize event end" handle in the month view. Controls: no `endEditable` from the host draws both handles, and a non-boolean `'false'` gets the default (both handles).

Updated `ObjectCalendar.endEditable-29020.test.tsx`: the two cases that pinned the top handle staying with no end field (one through `ObjectCalendar`, one on `CalendarView` directly) now assert it is gone; the end-field controls are untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- `.changeset/29020-calendar-resize-without-end-field.md` (unreleased) still says the top "Resize start" handle is unchanged. Both changesets ship in the same release, so the changelog will carry that line and this one's correction side by side. It is outside this claim's file surface and left as it is.
- The pointer-down guard is not reachable from a test: with `endEditable` false the top and bottom zones have no element to press. It keeps the gesture closed if a handle is drawn by some later change.
- `ui/packages/plugin-calendar/README.md` keeps its one-line summary ("Drag top/bottom edges to resize start/end times"), which stays true for views with an end field; it is outside this claim's file surface.
